subject.title: feat(ui): interleaved sidebar zone with custom session icons and drag ordering

question: Should OpenClaw accept the new persistent operator/agent-writable SVG session-icon contract, rendered by the Control UI after sanitizer validation, as part of the public `sessions.patch` surface?
rationale: The patch creates a new server-persisted, agent-facing SVG input and client-side HTML rendering boundary; test coverage helps, but deciding whether this capability belongs in the supported contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after hardening
options.body: Approve the icon contract after adding the `Intl.Segmenter` fallback and confirming the final CSS-budget and upgrade behavior on the reviewed head.

options.title: Limit icons to non-SVG forms
options.body: Keep curated names and single emoji but remove agent-drawn SVG support to avoid adding a persistent HTML-rendering input contract.

options.title: Split the contract from sidebar ordering
options.body: Land the interleaved sidebar preference work separately and defer the gateway and agent icon API until its security boundary is explicitly designed.

recommendation.title: Accept after hardening
recommendation.body: Approve the icon contract after adding the `Intl.Segmenter` fallback and confirming the final CSS-budget and upgrade behavior on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR author is the only evidence-backed routing contact supplied for the new protocol, gateway, and UI behavior; repository-history ownership could not be completed in the read-only sandbox.
